item.title: Commit to equity, quality in education
item.description: With the national election just 18 days away, political parties are finalising their manifestos. The Daily Star spoke to experts to identify the pressing issues that should top the agenda for parties.

item.title: Half the children can’t read, comprehend
item.description: As the government aims to raise the country’s literacy rate to between 86 and 90 percent by 2030, nearly half of children aged seven to 14 still fail to read and understand a simple story.

item.title: Can BNP protect journalists from its own rank and file?

item.title: July uprising: AL govt, oppositions used children as pawns
item.description: Both the previous government (Awami League) and opposition groups recruited, paid, and used children in violence during the July uprising, a United Nations Fact-Finding Mission has reported.

item.title: Govt plans Tk 21,900cr digital makeover for schools
item.description: According to proposals by the Directorate of Secondary and Higher Education (DSHE), the projects will cover half of the 20,767 secondary and higher secondary educational institutions and be implemented between January 2027 and December 2031.

But educationists are criticising the timing and intent of the move as most of these top positions in at least 47 universities have already been filled.
